scope: Only official documentation article TOC/body; exclude global navigation/footer/share/edit links from pool
selection_rule: For each original-request token, longest exact case-insensitive substring of TOC label wins; ties DOM first. Take matched functional li subtree and all its actual a[href] in DOM order, including matched anchor. If fewer than 6 keep blanks; do not add unrelated adjacent branches. If no match, use same heading section in body, else main article first6 links excluding edit-this-page.
version_rule: Use actual version URL only when present in publisher HTML href; never rewrite current URLs to infer past v4. If none, current snapshot links are diagnostic and cannot qualify V1 required historical version.
